_comment: Candidate engine v0 thresholds. Observations, not alerts. Changing a value changes rules_version only through a git commit.

watchlist._comment: probation = every new pump coin for early_window_s seconds (unique-buyer counts come from here); probation_reserve of the cap slots can only be used by probation, the other reasons share the rest (milestone 4: the watchlist used to fill up with meta_burst and starve probation). meta_burst_per_meta youngest, not yet graduated coins of every bursting meta, at most meta_burst_max_total in all (strongest metas first); a meta's set is frozen while it bursts and released meta_burst_release_s after it stopped bursting (sets persisted in kv engine.meta_burst_sets). subscribe_graduations: a graduation puts the coin on the watchlist (reason graduation) only for a funded PumpPortal key; the RPC trade stream never subscribes after graduation (milestone 3), the tracker samples graduated coins. rpc_trades_cap caps the number of per-mint logsSubscribe subscriptions; above rpc_trades_cu_drop_fraction of the daily CU cap only the rpc_trades_keep_reasons_above_cu_fraction reasons keep a subscription (probation is dropped first). The per-subscription cap, the daily CU share and the hysteresis of the stream live in config/ingest.json -> rpc_trades.
